hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; up() { d=$(dirname "$f"); while :; do for n in "$@"; do [ -f "$d/$n" ] && { echo "$d"; return 0; }; done; [ "$d" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && return 1; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; }; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) r=$(up pyproject.toml) && cd "$r" && uv run --frozen -q ruff --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; uv run --frozen -q ruff check --fix -q -- "$f" >/dev/null; uv run --frozen -q ruff format -q -- "$f"; uv run --frozen -q ruff check -q -- "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; *) r=$(up biome.json biome.jsonc) && cd "$r" && [ -x node_modules/.bin/biome ] || exit 0; node_modules/.bin/biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true --colors=off -- "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac; exit 0
